description: Distribute caregiving duties across family and helpers.
notes: Coded against the Kit contract with a guarded inline fallback shim (window.Kit || ...); the real shared/kit.js landed mid-build and takes precedence — all 10 verified against the real kit: zero console/page errors, core interactions clicked, 1280x800 shot captured.
Calendar grid contains a dead first-pass loop before innerHTML reset — harmless, renders correctly.

notes.note: The fairness-aware framing is the insight — caregiving inequality destroys families silently. But the wedge is a shared calendar, and shared calendars are free; the jump from 'fair calendar' to '$8/mo for respite marketplace' assumes a supply side you don't have. Shrink the ambition: sell the fairness report, not the OS.
